There are several '''quests''' in {{TWMS}}. Some of them need to be completed before the next quests can be found on the map.

Both active and completed quests are shown in the Journal.

The list of quests is sorted by recommended walkthrough order, since some of them are interconnected or require reaching higher levels to be unlocked.
